name: Haro 5a IRS

images.credit: Kóspál et al. 2021, Fig. 1 (Haro 5a IRS panel, crop)

paper.title: Massive Compact Disks around FU Orionis-type Young Eruptive Stars Revealed by ALMA

notes: Embedded FUor-like object in the Orion Nebula Cluster (IRAS 05329-0505). ALMA 1.33 mm continuum shows the inclined disk (A) plus a newly detected companion Haro 5a IRS B 0.70 arcsec to the southwest. Distance from Grosschedl et al. 2018 (391 pc).
